title: Feedback: the app feels painfully slow and frustrating
summary: This feels like an almost anti-human invention. The app is painfully slow, frustrating to use, and makes me wonder why something like this was designed this way in the first place. Instead of making things easier, it just adds waiting, confusion, and boredom. The whole experience feels dull, inefficient, and honestly not worth the time.

title: Black bar at the top of the video when fullscreening for the first time
summary: Almost every time I go full screen in a video, a black bar appears at the top, and the bottom part of the video is cut off: The only workaround I have found is minimizing the video and make another attempt to full screen again. This is a pretty frustrating bug to an otherwise awesome script, so I hope you will fix it!
